gaps: J1: imports kind misclassified usage_contextual instead of import_based — the tier classifier has no 'imports' branch (the TS T1 / JVM K8 finding): every ES6/require/re-export dependency edge falls to usage_contextual

J2: dynamic import('./lazy') emits a spurious calls -> import edge and NO imports edge for the module — TS7 was closed in the TS wave; the JS dynamic-import fixture currently documents the bug as accepted
J3: string interpolation `${x}` emits no Uses on the interpolated identifiers (TS3 T3 / kotlin K4 / scala G4 analog)

J4: obj.method() emits BOTH calls (obj.method -> method) AND uses (obj -> method, isFieldAccess) — the family contract (TS/kotlin/scala) skips the callee in uses because calls covers it; JS double-emits
J5: calls inside static { } blocks attribute to the MODULE, not the enclosing class — kotlin K7 init-attribution analog
J6: top-level const r = x instanceof T attributes the reference to 'global' instead of r — the resolveSource walk lacks variable_declarator (TS fixed this in the same wave)
J7: module-level destructured bindings (const { a } = obj / const [b] = arr) emit NO symbols — TS emits them as constants (probe-verified parity gap)

J8: JSX component usage emits NOTHING — <Button/> produces no edges. JSX is native to the JS grammar (8 types in the gate enumeration), unlike TS where it is a separate tsx dialect; the analyzer's detectsJsx only sets a pattern flag

JSD-744: M49 #744 (web fix wave, java #739 family contract): member-chain ROOT identifier dropped (config.inner.deeper.leaf emitted uses inner/deeper/leaf but not config) and BARE identifier reads (return config, if (flag)) emitted nothing — only member chains were scanned. Pre-fix the F5 javascript lane could not see either gap: its analyzer-side filter compared only calls, so uses was differential-invisible.

section-c-payload-matrix.detail: qualified_calls, docstrings, complexity, typeParameters, visibility, parameters

gaps: S1: template expressions emit NO references to the component's own members — {count}, label={label}, {#each items as item} (collection), {#await promise then value}, {@html raw}, {@const x = items.length}, {@debug items}, <svelte:component this={Comp}> all read script-side state but zero Uses/references edges are emitted. Only on: directives (calls) and {@render} (calls) produce edges; the template<->script data-flow is otherwise entirely silent.

S2: let { a, b } = $props() double-declares each binding — extractSvelteDeclarations emits Property symbols (isSvelteProp/fromRunes, component-owned) AND the JS sub-analyzer's destructured Variable symbols (isConst/isDestructured, unowned) both survive the merge. Every rune-prop binding appears twice with conflicting kinds/ownership, polluting symbol consumers.

S5: template-local each-loop and {@const} bindings that collide with same-named component members leaked false template Uses edges. {#each rows as row} and nested {#each ... as item} read local values, not member functions; {@const total = ...} is local to its enclosing block and must shadow the member only after its declaration.

S6: the same reactive state variable assigned by multiple `$:` blocks was emitted once per block, and the JS/TS sub-analyzer's plain declaration survived alongside the Svelte-owned reactive symbol, producing duplicate symbols and ambiguous containment.

H1: shorthand attributes `<Comp {value} />` parse as attribute with the whole `{value}` as the NAME (no expression child), so no walk ever visited them — the most idiomatic Svelte 5 prop-passing shape emitted no use.

H2: bare `this={X}` values were never read, so dynamic component targets were invisible. Member-bound targets (this={fn}) already flowed through the generic expression path as Uses; import-bound targets had no edge at all.

H3: `<Comp {...props} />` carries the whole spread expression in the attribute NAME with no expression child — member use for props was never emitted. Full key expansion would be constant evaluation (out of scope); the spread argument reads as one use.

H4: script-derived ranges were half-mapped: symbols shifted lines (columns only when starting on the script's first line, indices never); imports shifted lines only; exports and errors were pushed fully raw. Same disease class as Vue H2/H3, wider (all three dimensions on errors).

M1: the then/catch seeding appended a phantom literal entry shadowing identifier x in EVERY await block subtree, so a real member x read inside any await block emitted nothing — over-shadowing by hardcoded hack.
M2: the flat identifier regex read string contents as member reads: f("a=b") emitted Uses(a) + Uses(b) alongside the real f (Vue D1 analog, unshared code).

M3: member-chain leaves misattributed: user.name emitted Uses(name) alongside Uses(user) when a member shared the leaf name (Vue M1 analog). Dotted callee leaves and ?./#-preceded tokens skipped as receivers.

M4: `{#await promise then value}` / `as d` (no explicit block node) never registered the inline vars as template-locals, so {value}/{d} leaked as false member uses — companion to M1 (block form over-shadowed, inline form under-shadowed).
D1: module-block exports were pushed raw with script-relative ranges — the H4 wave shifted symbols/imports/errors but missed the export push. Same disease, one loop.

D3: the template char-walk had no comment states: `{f(a) /* b */}` read member b, multi-line `{url // pick}` read member pick. D2 (aliased this=) probed clean in the same battery — items carry local names.

D4: `{@render helpers.row(it)}` resolved to the FIRST segment (calls helpers — a namespace object, never callable) while on: dotted handlers resolve to the LAST (`box.open` -> open). Same shape, opposite answers.

D5: {#if cond}, {:else if cond} and {#key exp} heads carry opaque svelte_raw_text with no `expression` node — nothing ever collected them. Every earlier fixture masked the hole because each condition member was ALSO read elsewhere; isolated conditions emitted zero edges.

gaps: V1: script-setup compiler macros in the TYPE-LITERAL generic form — defineProps<{ id: string }>() and defineEmits<{ (e: 'save'): void }>() — emit NO prop/event symbols. Only the runtime object/array form ({ size: Number } / ['change']) is extracted; the standard Vue 3.3+ generic form loses the entire public contract.

V2: template expressions emit NO references to the component's own members — {{ count }}, @click="onSave", :label="label", v-model="count", v-if="show" read script-side state but no Uses/references edge is emitted. The template<->script data-flow is entirely silent.

V3: duplicate contains edges — the JS/TS sub-analyzer already emits contains for script-side symbols (class -> method), and the vue analyzer's own contains pass re-emitted them, doubling every class member's containment edge in the analyzer output (the store dedupes at INSERT, but the analyzer result and any consumer of it saw 2x).

V4: scope-blind template uses — v-for loop variables (v-for="item in items") and slot props (#default="{ row }") are template-LOCAL bindings, but the V2 collector emitted Uses to them whenever a same-named script member existed. False edges: the template reads the local item/row, not the member. The TS T6 shadowed-local bug class, unguarded in the template surface.
